stories.body: WTEN News10 reported that rain and wind caused a chilly weekend in New York, according to the source. A warm front lifting through the region produced widespread heavy rainfall, with a lull in showers from mid-morning through the early afternoon. A cold front then swung through, bringing a late-autumn air mass for the weekend.
